headline: Jefferson is active and Addison is out, so keep Jefferson in and Hockenson on the bench. No swaps needed for the 10 AM games.
alerts: 8:31 AM: Justin Jefferson is active vs. the Saints. Jordan Addison is inactive. Keep Jefferson at WR.
8:40 AM: Terry McLaurin is active but expected to be on limited snaps. Leave him on the bench.
8:39 AM: Bears ruled out Caleb Williams again. Tyson Bagent starts, a small boost for the Packers and Matthew Golden.
Josh Downs is not on the Colts inactive list. Keep him in the FLEX.

10 AM: Vikings, Commanders, Colts, Packers and Jets games lock. Sleeper could not be reached this run, so confirm in the app that Jefferson, St. Brown, Downs and Golden or Mitchell are in your starting slots.

PHI.note: London game at 6:30 AM Pacific. Hurts is active. Jaguars still favored by 7.5 with a 41.5 total.

BAL.note: Lamar Jackson is out. Backup quarterback starts.

ATL.note: Sunday night, 5:20 PM Pacific. Line flipped from Ravens -6 to Falcons -3 after Lamar Jackson was ruled out.

DAL.note: Played Thursday night. Points are final.

TB.note: Played Thursday night. Points are final.

MIN.note: 10 AM Pacific at New Orleans. Jefferson active, Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. inactive.

WAS.note: 10 AM Pacific vs. Giants. McLaurin active but expected on limited snaps. Diggs inactive.

GB.note: Packers at Bears. Caleb Williams inactive again, Tyson Bagent starts for Chicago.

IND.note: 10 AM Pacific at Pittsburgh. Slayton and Dulin inactive. Downs active.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: Lions are favored by 5.5 with a 54.5 total, so Arizona projects for about 24.5 points, 7 or 8 more than the Eagles.
Trailing script should keep him throwing. Dimers projects about 265 passing yards.
Late afternoon kickoff, so you keep all the morning news before he locks.

6904.name: Jalen Hurts
notes: Active for London. No surprise inactives for the Eagles offense beyond Saquon Barkley.
Eagles are 7.5-point underdogs with a 41.5 total, about 17 implied points.
Locks at 6:30 AM Pacific, before any late injury news on your other players.

sources.title: Inquirer: Eagles vs. Jaguars odds and props

8154.name: Brian Robinson
notes: Steady No. 2 back behind Bijan Robinson with goal-line work: 4 TDs over the last two games.
Falcons are 3-point favorites after the line flipped from Ravens -6, and Lamar Jackson is out, so a lead and late carries are likely.
Touchdown dependent. He catches very few passes.

9511.name: Keaton Mitchell
notes: Led the Chargers backfield in Week 4: 10 carries plus 6 targets, ahead of Omarion Hampton.
Still a three-way committee with Hampton and Kimani Vidal, and the Chargers project for only about 19 points against Denver.
Coin flip with Lloyd. Mitchell gets the slight edge on passing-game work.

11581.name: MarShawn Lloyd
notes: Lead back only because Josh Jacobs is on the exempt list, but averaging 2.7 yards per carry with no game over 10 points.
Split carries with Kaleb Johnson last week (7 to 8), though he caught 5 passes.

sources.title: Yardbarker: Lloyd is now a stash

7547.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
notes: Lions project for about 30 points, tied for the highest team total of the week.

6794.name: Justin Jefferson
notes: Active vs. the Saints. No snap limit was reported, though he carries some reinjury risk on the ankle.
Jordan Addison is inactive, so Jefferson should see an even bigger target share.
DraftKings has his catches at 6.5.

5844.name: T.J. Hockenson
notes: Stays on the bench because Jefferson is active. With Addison out he gets a few more looks, but not enough to start over your FLEX options.
Caught all 13 targets for 119 yards in Week 4 with Jefferson out.

sources.title: Draft Sharks: Jefferson active, Addison inactive

5927.name: Terry McLaurin
notes: Active vs. the Giants, per the CBS inactives tracker.
Mike Garafolo reported his snaps are expected to be limited, so he stays a bench player this week.
ESPN's John Keim calls it only a slight lean to play.

sources.title: SI: Is Terry McLaurin playing today?

12501.name: Matthew Golden
notes: Bears ruled out Caleb Williams again and Tyson Bagent starts, which should help Green Bay control the game.
Seven targets and a TD in Week 4, his second straight game with a score.
The line moved toward Chicago this week, now about Bears -1.5 with a 47.5 total, so Green Bay projects near 23 points.

sources.title: NBC Sports: Golden scores in Week 4

9500.name: Josh Downs
notes: Not on the Colts inactive list. Darius Slayton and Ashton Dulin are out, which thins the target competition.
Healthy, with no injury tag. Steelers favored by 3 with a 43.5 total, so the Colts project for about 20 points.

notes: Played Thursday night, so his points are already locked in.

notes: Jets are 2.5-point home favorites over Cleveland with a 39.5 total, holding the Browns to about 18.5 implied points.

notes: Listed Out on Sleeper this week.
